scope: Descriptive paired binary64 replay of archived trajectories. No new probes, matrix actions, timing data, independent paths, or empirical coverage claims. Reference comparisons use the stored operator trace references. The fixed settings each have nominal risk alpha.

methods.raw_current: Current frozen-norm interval with alpha assigned to the two signed tests.
methods.same_risk_current: Current frozen-norm interval at alpha with the Proposition 1 floor sqrt(V/K1).
methods.split_risk_current: Current frozen-norm interval at alpha/2 with the Theorem 3 floor sqrt(V/K) at risk alpha/2.
methods.running_norm: Running intersection of current frozen-norm intervals at alpha on the indicated grid.

same_risk_justification: On the original simultaneous coverage event the true scale survives every hypothetical probe-by-probe report. Proposition 1 then bounds V/T_true^2 by K1 at every probe. The floor holds on that same event even when earlier intervals were never computed.
stopping_rule: First scheduled positive finite nonempty interval with radius at most the target. A cap exit has restricted cost equal to the cap and counts as no completion. Reference exclusions and interval differences use the full grid through the cap.
pathwise_width_caps_scope: Exact-arithmetic bounds at any report reaching the indicated probe count with a nonempty interval. For the running rule, the first and subsequent gaps must be at most the specified gap. A grid must actually report at or after the sufficient count, and counts beyond the replay cap are theoretical. An empty interval provides no certificate. Raw current has no pathwise vanishing width bound at an isolated report. Its simultaneous coverage event permits a separate bound.

isolated_report_diagnostic.construction: A is diagonal with eigenvalues 1/2 and 1/(2 m^2) repeated m^2 times. Use scaled distinct coordinate probes so q is 60 at probe one and 0.3 thereafter. Each probe removes its coordinate eigenvalue.
isolated_report_diagnostic.scope: A deterministic diagnostic with trace one, excluded from the archive summaries. The running interval at a first report equals raw_current. The two-report interval retains the additional constraint at probe one.
